topic: EXP-501 P1: quadruple-failure headline paragraph inserted into part1 Overview between scorecard and falsifiability callout
our_argument_summary:
EXP-501 P1 inserts a single ~85-word paragraph in data/sections.json:part1 between the closing of the 4-card scorecard and the opening
of the overview-what-would-change falsifiability callout. The paragraph reads: 'The same data, complementary framing: {{CA_QUAD_FAIL}} of {{CA_REVIEWED}} reviewed WINs simultaneously fail all four structural-failure tests — no live monitoring, relabels of standard physics, post-hoc adoption, and no derivation from dome geometry. The strict Survive Scrutiny count above is zero passing; the converse count is most of the registry. See Part 2b §§2b.4.' Cross-link uses href="#part2b" + onclick=showTab('selftest'). Patch closes HOL-MISSING.c2 hole 4 (ISS-2337) per decider commit 0d27a28.

dome_code_analysis.calculation_pipeline: {{CA_QUAD_FAIL}} and {{CA_REVIEWED}} are substituted at build time from context.codeAnalysis.{quadFail,reviewed}. Live recomputation against data/wins.json this run: 47 of 71 reviewed WINs (66.2%) — 47 of 72 total (65.3%). EXP-501 quoted 47/71 in honest_correction_to_curmudgeon; HOL-MISSING.c2 hole 4 quoted 48/72 (67%) at authoring time 2026-05-30. The qualitative phrase 'nearly two-thirds' in §2b.4 covers both numbers; no goalpost-moving concern.
dome_code_analysis.hardcoded_vs_computed: Computed at build time via template substitution — no hardcoded number in the inserted paragraph. This matches the EXP-441/442 discipline applied across the document.
data_sources_used: data/wins.json (numerator via direct enumeration of code_analysis_tags fields)
dome_code_analysis.escape_clauses: None. Denominator is 'reviewed WINs' (71 today), which is the same denominator §2b.4 uses; consistency across the document defends against denominator-shopping objections.
dome_code_analysis.code_discrepancies: None. Template variables map correctly; counts verified against current wins.json.

code_analysis_tags.monitoring_evidence: This is a sections review, not a WIN — code_analysis_tags do not strictly apply. Defaulting to none/false/false/false. (Per curmudgeon.md the tags are required on WIN reviews; SEC reviews historically supply default values.)

holes_found.description: Typo in the cross-link label: rendered text is 'Part 2b §§2b.4' (double section symbol) but EXP-501's replacement_text specified 'Part 2b §2b.4' (single §). Confirmed by grep -oP 'Part 2b §+2b\.4' against both files: EXP-501 source returns three single-§ instances, sections.json returns one double-§§ instance. The §§ string occurs nowhere else in sections.json (verified: §§ count=1 globally, § count=24). The cross-link href="#part2b" and onclick handler still resolve, so navigation is functional — this is cosmetic. Likely introduced when the decider applied the patch; the integration step's anchor-text replacement must have collided with an existing § character adjacent to the insertion point, doubling it.
holes_found.recommendation: Decider: one-line edit replacing '§§2b.4' with '§2b.4' in part1.html. Trivial sed: sed -i 's/§§2b\.4/§2b.4/' on the file, or a 4-byte JSON edit. No content review needed.

holes_found.description: The simplification 'no live monitoring' covers both monitoring=hardcoded AND monitoring=none in the underlying tag schema, but a careful reader could ask 'what about WINs with hardcoded monitoring that does pull from a source URL but compares against a baked-in threshold?' (§2b.4 says 'monitoring is absent or hardcoded'; the Overview paragraph drops 'absent or' for brevity). The simplification does not mislead — both 'absent' and 'hardcoded' fail the live-data test by design — but a defender could argue the term collapses a structural distinction. The §2b.4 cross-link mitigates by providing the full methodology one click away.
holes_found.recommendation: Acceptable as-is given the cross-link. If the decider wants extra rigor, replace 'no live monitoring' with 'no live or absent monitoring' (5 chars added). Not blocking.

stronger_arguments.description: The 47-WIN quadruple-failure cohort overlaps significantly with the recycled-prediction cluster (Schumann resonances WIN-001/002/029/038/061; tidal constituents WIN-045/046/049/050/051; per §2b.4 enumeration). A more devastating framing would note that the dome's quadruple failures cluster on its most-recycled claim families — i.e., the WINs the dome cites most prominently as 'confirmed predictions' are precisely the ones most structurally compromised. The current paragraph defers this to §2b.4's enumeration; a future revision could surface the family-level pattern at Overview scope. Not blocking — this is enhancement, not correction.

kernel_of_truth.description: The patch is well-targeted and disciplined. Three things it gets right: (1) Live template placeholders ({{CA_QUAD_FAIL}}, {{CA_REVIEWED}}) tie the headline to wins.json so future tag corrections automatically propagate — no hardcoded number to rot (build-scripts/generate-html.js:99,112 confirms template wiring). (2) The four conditions match §2b.4's framing one-to-one: (a) monitoring hardcoded/absent → 'no live monitoring', (b) relabels_standard=true → 'relabels of standard physics', (c) post_hoc=true → 'post-hoc adoption', (d) derives_from_dome=false → 'no derivation from dome geometry' (data/sections.json:part2b §2b.4 'Cross-Cutting Structural Analysis'). (3) Placement between scorecard and falsifiability callout is rhetorically defensible: scorecard shows raw counts (Claims/Surviving/Acknowledged/Silent), falsifiability callout shows the strict 0-PASS framing, and the new paragraph adds the symmetric 47-FAIL framing as the converse cut. The cross-link (href=#part2b, showTab('selftest')) uses the same pattern as the four other part2b cross-refs in part1.html (verified at index ~3607, ~20172, ~68370).
kernel_of_truth.why_it_doesnt_save_claim: N/A — this isn't a dome WIN we're attacking, it's an EXP integration we're verifying. The 'why this doesn't save the dome' kernel-of-truth schema doesn't apply directly. Reframed: the patch's strengths above do not eliminate the holes_found items (the §§ typo and the 'no live monitoring' brevity), but neither hole undermines the structural claim. The patch ships, with one decider-level minor cleanup needed (data/sections.json:part1.html '§§2b.4' → '§2b.4').

text_fingerprint.verdict: patch lands, minor §§ typo to clean up

deeper_analysis: Adversarial pass against a dome defender's perspective: (1) Front-loading objection — 'one more anti-dome stat in the Overview tips the page from evidence-first to thesis-first'. The patch is one paragraph mirroring the existing '0 Survive Scrutiny' scorecard card from the opposite framing; the Overview already carries the strict-PASS=0 conclusion, so the converse-FAIL=47 framing is not a new conclusion. Counter-mitigation is the cross-link to §2b.4 for methodology. (2) Denominator-shopping objection — 'why 47/71 reviewed instead of 47/72 total?'. The prose says 'reviewed WINs' explicitly; §2b.4 uses the same denominator. The 1 unreviewed WIN is excluded because its tags have not been audited (the same discipline §2b.4 applies). Defender's counter falls flat. (3) Tag-subjectivity objection — 'the four tests are curmudgeon judgment, not raw structure'. The cross-link to §2b.4 surfaces the methodology; per-WIN evidence strings (relabels_standard_evidence, post_hoc_evidence, etc.) are auditable in wins.json. Each tag has an evidence string explaining the call. (4) Simplification objection — 'no live monitoring' collapses hardcoded vs absent. Documented in holes_found as a minor — does not mislead because both fail the live-data test. (5) Cosmetic typo — '§§2b.4'. Confirmed via grep that EXP-501 source had single § everywhere; integration introduced the double. Decider one-line fix. Overall: the patch is structurally sound and rhetorically appropriate. ISS-2337 / HOL-MISSING.c2 hole 4 is closed by this integration (the headline stat now appears at Overview scope). The §§ typo is a separate minor cosmetic ISS the decider should open and self-apply.

summary_for_decider: EXP-501 P1 closes HOL-MISSING.c2 hole 4 / ISS-2337 cleanly. The headline quadruple-failure stat now appears at Overview scope between scorecard and falsifiability callout, using live {{CA_QUAD_FAIL}}/{{CA_REVIEWED}} placeholders (no hardcoded counts). Framing matches §2b.4 one-to-one across all four structural-failure tests. Cross-link href and tab handler are correct. Recommend a one-line decider self-apply: replace '§§2b.4' with '§2b.4' in data/sections.json:part1.html. Second minor finding ('no live monitoring' brevity) is acceptable as-is given the cross-link.
